core_law.common_policy: For an uncertainty cell W with adequate-action sets A(w), if the intersection of all A(w) is nonempty, compile and verify one common Brain-owned adequate policy.
core_law.tournament_failure: If the intersection is empty, no single policy is adequate for every world in the cell. A sound route must obtain a pre-commitment discriminator or use independently justified persistent distinguishing state.
core_law.minimum_persistent_information: If k distinct adequate policy classes are minimally required, the declared selector model needs at least ceil(log2(k)) persistent bits.

execution_rules: Freeze only the terminal objective and hard constraints; all intermediate decompositions remain falsifiable.
Treat benchmarks and family labels as evidence sources, not capability ontology.
Try a common adequate policy before acquiring new target-relative information.
When no common policy exists, seek the minimum pre-commitment JIT discriminator.
Admit persistent distinguishing state only with content-addressed necessity evidence and independent verification.
Schedule concrete counterexample cells, not historical taxonomy labels.
Prefer reusable repairs that discharge multiple terminal obligations.
Unknown or incomparable remains not proved.
